articles.title: GPT-5.2 derives a new result in theoretical physics

concepts_taught.name: Collaboration between LLMs and human experts in scientific research

prerequisites.name: Basic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs)

learning_outcomes: Understand how Large Language Models can be applied to theoretical physics research
Recognize the potential for LLMs to derive new scientific results and collaborate with human experts
Appreciate the importance of verification and validation of LLM-generated scientific results
strategic_questions: What are the implications of LLMs deriving new scientific results for the future of research and discovery?
How can we ensure the accuracy and reliability of scientific results generated by LLMs?
What are the potential applications and limitations of LLMs in theoretical physics and other scientific fields?

prerequisites.name: Basic understanding of natural language processing

learning_outcomes: Understand how to leverage GPT for social science research
Learn about the potential of qualitative to quantitative data conversion
Familiarize with the GABRIEL open-source toolkit
strategic_questions: How can GPT-based tools impact the field of social science research?
What are the potential limitations and biases of using AI for qualitative data analysis?
How can researchers ensure the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated quantitative data?

learning_outcomes: Understand the concept of real-time coding models
Learn about the importance of context window size in language models
strategic_questions: How will real-time coding models change the way we approach software development?
What are the potential applications of large context window sizes in language models?

articles.title: GPT-5 lowers the cost of cell-free protein synthesis

learning_outcomes: Understand how GPT-5 can be applied to optimize cell-free protein synthesis
Learn about the benefits of closed-loop experimentation in autonomous labs
Recognize the potential of large language models in biotechnology
strategic_questions: How can large language models like GPT-5 be further integrated into biotechnology workflows?
What are the potential cost savings and efficiency gains of using autonomous labs for protein synthesis?
What are the potential applications of closed-loop experimentation in other fields beyond biotechnology?
